order_wins: **Vascon Engineers** — receives a **Letter of Acceptance worth Rs 198.00 crore** from State Bank of India for construction of SBILD, residential flats and other commercial outfits at Hinjewadi, Pune, due within 24 months _(~28.3% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**B. L. Kashyap and Sons** — wins a **Rs 200.02 crore** (excl. GST), 25-month order from Nourish Developers for Commercial Building Civil Structure Works (Phase 3), One DXP, Sector 113, Gurugram _(~15.2% of mcap)_.

**LCC Projects** — receives an Acceptance of Tender from the Government of Gujarat's Sauni Yojana Division for a 10-year EPC-plus-O&M water-supply project valued at **Rs 151.57 crore** (excl. GST) _(mcap n/a)_.

**GPT Infraprojects** — step-down subsidiary Alcon Builders wins a **Rs 149.50 crore** (incl. GST; Rs 126.70 cr excl.) railway-signalling contract from Western Railway's Bhavnagar Division, converting its 3-Oct L1 status into an award, due in 730 days _(~9.5% of mcap)_.

**Organic Recycling Systems** — its wholly owned subsidiary Solapur Bioenergy Systems secures a **5th Large-Scale EPCOM contract worth Rs 100.00 crore** from Bharat Petroleum Corporation for a CBG plant at Bhilai, Chhattisgarh _(~31.8% of mcap)_.

**Dynacons Systems & Solutions** — secures a **Rs 137.15 crore, 3-year project from the Supreme Court of India** to supply, install and commission 728 servers hosting the Case Information System across District Courts nationwide _(~10.6% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants** — receives a **Rs 51.20 crore Letter of Acceptance from Southern Railway** for traffic/location surveys and DPR work on new BG line and doubling projects _(~15.1% of mcap)_.

**RDB Infrastructure and Power** — receives a **Rs 20.00 crore** Notice of Award from Oswal Residential Building for construction of an Experience Centre at New Town and Titagarh, Kolkata _(~5.3% of mcap)_.

**Magellanic Cloud** — wholly owned subsidiary Provigil Surveillance secures a **Rs 29.13 crore Letter of Acceptance from Northern Railway, Moradabad Division** for CCTV/e-surveillance at railway stations for Kumbh Mela 2027, due in 3 months plus a 5-year AMC _(mcap n/a)_.
**Newgen Software Technologies** — UK subsidiary signs a **GBP 1.63 million (~Rs 20.51 crore) document-management deal** with Just Retirement Management Services, a 3.5-year engagement _(mcap n/a)_.
**Dhabriya Polywood** — receives a **Rs 11.79 crore uPVC doors-and-windows work order** from Conscient Group, to be executed over 24 months _(~2.2% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Siyaram Recycling Industries** — secures a **Rs 4.00 crore brass-billet export order from Green Metals FZCO, Dubai** _(~5.1% of mcap)_ — a second, smaller order from the same counterparty inside a week.
**Happy Square Outsourcing (WhiteForce)** — receives a **Rs 1.51 crore** staffing work order from Hindustan Copper, running 17-Oct-2026 to 16-Oct-2027 _(~3.7% of mcap)_.
**KSB** — receives an order from Oil and Natural Gas Corporation for replacement of 7 main injection pumps, approx. **Rs 85 crore**, delivery by FY2029 _(mcap n/a)_.

**Acme Solar Holdings** — subsidiary ACME Greentech Twenty executes a Power Purchase Agreement with SECI for a 300 MW assured-peak-power project under FDRE Tranche IX; value not disclosed _(mcap n/a)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Ujjivan Small Finance Bank** — board approves a **preferential issue of up to 6.32 crore equity shares at Rs 64.73** to International Finance Corporation, Bajaj Life Insurance, Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance and HDFC Life Insurance, aggregating up to **Rs 409.04 crore**, subject to shareholder approval at the 13-Nov EGM.

**Regency Fincorp** — board approves a combined **preferential issue of equity shares (Rs 72.04 cr) and warrants (Rs 240.11 cr) to promoters and non-promoters, aggregating Rs 312.15 crore** _(~51.6% of mcap)_, subject to shareholder approval at an EGM.

**Urban Company** — board approves an enabling resolution to raise up to **Rs 2,500 crore** via equity shares, warrants or convertible securities, subject to shareholder postal-ballot and regulatory approval; no instrument, price or investor named yet.
**Sahana System** — board approves raising up to **Rs 125.00 crore** via 13,15,789 equity warrants at Rs 950 each, on preferential basis to non-promoter investors, subject to shareholder approval.
equity_allotments: **ASM Technologies** — executes a preferential allotment of 10,78,974 equity shares at Rs 4,875 each, aggregating **Rs 526.00 crore**, including Rs 50.00 crore to Derive Trading and Resorts _(★ allotted to Derive Trading and Resorts Private Limited (Radhakishan Damani))_.

**Standard Engineering Technology** (formerly Standard Glass Lining) — allots 24,39,750 preferential equity shares at **Rs 293** (incl. Rs 283 premium) to AGI Group Holdings and Monoflus Pte Ltd, for **Rs 71.48 crore**, per its 10-Aug EGM approval.

**Affle 3i** — promoter Affle Holdings Pte Ltd remits **USD 34.99 million (Rs 332.51 crore)** to exercise its 18-Jun-2026 warrants into equity shares, taking total warrant subscription-and-exercise proceeds to **Rs 611.50 crore (USD 64.49 million)**.

**Mantra Capital** — promoter Deepa Kishor Tracy converts 30 lakh warrants (part of an April-2026 Rs 9.00 crore preferential issue) into equity shares for **Rs 6.00 crore** _(our arithmetic: 30 lakh x Rs 20)_.
**Shelter Pharma** — promoter Mustaqim Nisarahmed Sabugar converts 4.65 lakh warrants (issued August-2025) into equity shares for **Rs 1.47 crore**, completing his outstanding warrant balance.
**Kataria Industries** — allots 47,44,200 preferential equity shares at Rs 106 (incl. Rs 96 premium), aggregating **Rs 50.29 crore**, per shareholder approval.
m_and_a: **Anuh Pharma** — signs an Asset Transfer Agreement to acquire Vanquest Pharma's API manufacturing facility at Tarapur, Boisar for **Rs 72.90 crore**, adding 525 MTPA of production capacity _(mcap n/a)_.
**Jammu & Kashmir Bank** — completes sale of its stake in PNB MetLife India Insurance to MetLife International Holdings and Barclays entities at Rs 117.20 a share, for **Rs 120.10 crore**.

**Heritage Foods** — completes its phased acquisition of Heritage Novandie Foods, taking its stake from 94.40% to 100%; Novandie becomes a wholly owned subsidiary (consideration not disclosed in this filing).
**RBL Bank** — receives RBI approval to amalgamate Emirates NBD Bank's Indian branches into RBL Bank, effective 1-December-2026 (first disclosed 12-Nov-2025); no consideration disclosed.

**Adroit Infotech** — enters a non-binding agreement to acquire a majority stake in Croatia's Verso Altima Group D.O.O. (SAP BRIM/telecom integrator, ~EUR 13 mn standalone revenue); consideration not disclosed, to be funded via accruals, preferential and rights-issue proceeds.

**Varroc Engineering** — agrees to acquire a 45% stake in EV battery-pack maker Forsee Power India (FY26 turnover Rs 18.84 cr) for an initial consideration not exceeding **Rs 0.45 crore**, plus optionally convertible preference shares.
capex_core: **Vraj Iron and Steel** — Addendum of Fresh Terms of Reference (ToR) for the Greenfield Steel Plant Project from MoEF&CC.
**Rockingdeals Circular Economy** — capacity addition with respect to organized retail grocery stores.

**Indo Rama Synthetics** — board approves a **~Rs 200 crore** capex expansion for speciality filament and fibre production at its Butibori plant, Nagpur, financed via term loan and internal accruals, commercial operations expected in 12-18 months _(mcap n/a)_.
business_updates: **Results season** — **53 companies filed** results or earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Dachepalli Publishers** — H1 FY27 revenue of **Rs 70.01 crore, up 71.76% YoY**; signs an MoU to acquire Hara Communications, subject to due diligence and definitive agreements.

**Novateor Research Laboratories** — enters an exclusive 3-year manufacturing-and-supply agreement with Pidilite Industries for enzyme-based Aligner Cleaning Foam and Tooth Brightening Strips; pricing not disclosed, set per purchase order.
**Onward Technologies** — Q2 FY27 revenue up 22.2% YoY to **Rs 171.2 crore**, EBITDA up 33.7%; separately secures a **multi-year contract renewal valued at Rs 44.46 crore**.

**Australian Premium Solar (India)** — commissions another 400 MW TOPCon module line, taking total module capacity to **1.2 GW** (+50%); FY26 consolidated income rose 60.7% to **Rs 708.74 crore**, PAT up 44.3% to Rs 57.87 crore.
**Solara Active Pharma Sciences** — Q2 FY27 revenue grows **33% YoY to Rs 417.8 crore**, EBITDA more than doubles to Rs 76.9 crore — its best quarter in five years.
**Juniper Green Energy** — subsidiary commissions 65.40 MW of wind capacity, taking its FDRE project to **434.35 MWp** of a planned 550.6 MWp (+~201 MWh BESS).
distress_risk: **Tata Chemicals** — a Mumbai Centre for International Arbitration tribunal unanimously **rejects Allied Silica's Rs 908 crore claim**, directing Tata Chemicals to pay only a **Rs 1 crore** principal plus interest and costs (one member dissenting).

**Yes Bank** — Supreme Court upholds the Bombay High Court's setting-aside of the 2020 write-down of **Rs 8,415 crore of Additional Tier-1 Bonds**, dismissing the Bank's, RBI's and the Union's appeals; the Bank estimates reinstatement cuts CET1 by **~250 bps**.

**Refex Industries** — the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals), Chennai, partly allows its appeal on a reassessment for AY2014-15: deletes a **Rs 36.39 lakh** depreciation disallowance but remands a **Rs 17.48 crore** LTCG addition to the Assessing Officer for fresh quantification.
**Dharmaj Crop Guard** — orders passed by the High Court of Himachal Pradesh.
**Tega Industries** — step-down subsidiary Tega McNally Minerals wins a favourable Calcutta High Court order quashing reassessment proceedings for AY2017-18, covering a **Rs 13.79 crore** tax demand.
**G R Infraprojects** — Madhya Pradesh High Court quashes a GST Show Cause Notice (Section 74, Ratlam Division) the company had challenged; amount not stated in the cached excerpt.
**Affle 3i** — Supreme Court stays CIRP proceedings against the company pending its appeal, over its investment in Talent Unlimited Online Services (Bobble).
credit_rating_changes: **Kalpataru Projects International** — CRISIL upgrades long-term bank-facility and Rs 150 crore NCD ratings to **AA+/Stable** from AA/Stable, reaffirms short-term at A1+; withdraws the rating on a separate NCD series fully repaid.
**GEE** — Infomerics upgrades its long-term bank-facility rating to IVR BBB/Stable from IVR BBB-/Stable, and short-term to IVR A3+ from IVR A3.
other_notable: **SIS** — extinguishes 14,85,134 equity shares bought back under its ongoing buyback (commenced 13-Aug).

**DEE Development Engineers** — signs a Framework Agreement with a domestic EPC contractor to jointly pursue nuclear-power-sector business, providing pre-bid support, design and piping manufacturing; no value disclosed _(mcap n/a)_.
